messages.content: tell me a joke about lion and cat.

Why did the lion invite the cat to his party?  
He heard she was purrfect at roaring up some fun—just on a smaller scale!

The lion asked the cat, "Why so small?"  
The cat replied, "So I can fit on your throne when you nap!"
what was the last line of the story you wrote?
"So I can fit on your throne when you nap!"
